A physician’s survey (1877) of the drugs of Āyurveda, from Caraka and Suśruta, plants, minerals and animal products, with their Sanskrit names and uses.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy of the Royal College of Physicians of Edinburgh; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The materia medica of the Hindus : compiled from Sanskrit medical works · Dutt, Udoy Chand, Royal College of Physicians of Edinburgh · 1877, 386 scanned pages. Published 1877; Udoy Chand Dutt died 1884; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit.
